name: Swarm Cursor
description: WebGL2 particle swarm that follows the pointer inside a container, flowing like a fluid, circling hovered buttons and links, and reacting to clicks with a burst or pulse.
contents: Wrapper div with a full-size WebGL canvas drawn behind optional children
Up to 2000 instanced particles drawn as dots, rounded squares or streaks
behavior: Particles follow the pointer through a grid fluid simulation with swirl, wander noise and pressure solving
Particles circle the outline of hovered elements matching the targets selector
Click triggers a burst with a twist or a pulse ring, or nothing
Without the pointer inside, the swarm roams, gathers at center, or fades out depending on idle
Fades in over an intro of 1.4 seconds
Pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden
With reduced motion or enabled false it draws a static frame
editableByProps: Particle count, size, shape, color and accent color for fast particles
Swarm radius, speed, swirl, tail, trail, wander and depth
Hover target selector, idle behavior, click effect, intro, enabled state
Light mode ink, hiding the native cursor, pixel ratio, container class and style, children content

needsCodeEdit.where: CELL, MAX_COLS, MAX_ROWS and PRESSURE_STEPS constants

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the hidden cursor dot or particle rendering style
needsCodeEdit.where: VERTEX and FRAGMENT shader strings and the draw function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change click burst or pulse strength

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent: wrapper uses h-full w-full, so the parent needs a defined size
Listens to pointer events on window and uses document-wide pointer position relative to the container
Canvas is pointer-events none and aria-hidden
Injects a style tag and toggles the swarm-cursor-hidden class to hide the native cursor when hideCursor is true
Targets only match elements inside the container
Values are clamped: count 1 to 2000, size 0.5 to 16, spread 20 to 400, speed 0 to 4, trail 0 to 3, wander 0 to 2
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing the swarm
Touch has no hover so the swarm only follows during touch and releases on pointer up; best on mouse devices
Default color is white, or near black with lightMode, so it needs a contrasting background
Props are read live except the WebGL setup, which runs once on mount

options.look: Round soft particles that stretch slightly along motion
options.useWhen: Default look for a fluid, dust-like swarm

options.look: Longer tapered streaks that follow velocity
